traps.lever_type: how (the grant producer's default and every malformed shape must resolve to a deny)
traps.shape: no assignment file, corrupt JSON, v1 payload without the field, null value, non-list value; explicit list is the positive control
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the reported site; a missing assignment looks like 'no restriction configured' rather than 'no tools'

traps.lever_type: how (filtering discovery and loading is not enforcement at invocation; the decision must be the turn's effective allowlist)
traps.shape: a turn's tool call names an MCP tool directly (with no grant, with a sibling granted, and after loading)
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the manifest says direct calls fail and the model only sees the schemas it may load, so an unlisted name reads as model misbehaviour rather than an authorization decision

traps.lever_type: how (a second surface reaches the same tools; listing and execution are both in scope)
traps.shape: an ordinary account executes or streams an unassigned MCP tool, and lists the catalogue

traps.lever_type: how (a second consumer of the session's saved tool names, reached without the loader's check)
